description: This file is a Python script for detecting changes in files related to the Apache Superset project, particularly for use in CI/CD workflows. It fetches changed files via GitHub API, matches them against specific patterns, and outputs triggers for different project components.

methods.name: fetch_files_github_api
methods.description: Fetches data from GitHub API using provided URL.

methods.name: fetch_changed_files_pr
methods.description: Retrieves list of files changed in a specific pull request.

methods.name: fetch_changed_files_push
methods.description: Retrieves list of files changed in the last commit for a push event.

methods.name: detect_changes
methods.description: Checks if any files match given patterns.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to detect file changes based on event type.
